evidence_level: L3 mechanism diagnostic; all 30 real decoder layers, held-out activations, not end-to-end model quality
representation: Q4_GROUP64 shared full-rank bases + Q4_GROUP64 U/V layer adapters; no dense shadow weights

scope.calibration: WikiText-2 raw train, 128 sampled activation rows/site
scope.evaluation: disjoint WikiText-2 raw test, 64 held-out activation rows/site

formal_precommitted_component_gate.pass_definition: main-projection packed reduction >=5x AND raw-energy-summed global operator NMSE <=0.05
formal_precommitted_component_gate.borderline_definition: reduction >=4x AND raw-energy-summed global operator NMSE <=0.10
formal_precommitted_component_gate.reason: The global numerator/denominator sum weights unlike operator sites by absolute output energy. Cross-operator output scales differ enough that this aggregate is dominated by a subset of high-energy sites and masks severe normalized errors in most matrices. The formal result is preserved rather than rewritten, but it is not accepted as evidence of component viability.

substantive_decision.reason: At every tested grouping/rank, normalized per-site errors remain very large. The FP32/unquantized residual-factor ceilings are already almost as poor as the Q4-packed results, proving that rank<=32 inter-layer residual structure—not factor quantization—is the dominant failure. Byte economics are strong but function preservation is not.

methodological_correction_for_future_run.prohibit: raw cross-operator energy-summed NMSE as a sole gate
methodological_correction_for_future_run.require: aggregate site-normalized errors first (median/mean/quantiles) and include operator-family constraints or worst-family guardrails
methodological_correction_for_future_run.rationale: Relative NMSE is dimensionless per site; summing raw numerator/denominator across heterogeneous sites reintroduces arbitrary output-scale weighting.

claim_boundary: Real pretrained operator/structural diagnostic only. The formal precommitted gate pass is retained for auditability but rejected as a validity signal because its aggregate metric was flawed. No end-to-end perplexity, task accuracy, native packed runtime, RSS or VRAM claim.
